wholeDecision.sourceSpan: Fachanforderungen Mathematik Sekundarstufe, Schleswig-Holstein 2024, Leitidee 4: Funktionaler Zusammenhang, Zeile 3530
wholeDecision.rationale: This source transition changes a function graph under vertical/horizontal addition and multiplication. Printed p66 expressly lists shifts, scaling and both axis reflections in the same block. The three atomic targets describe precisely these actions; they do not establish a matrix, Markov or fixed-vector obligation, and this correction does not independently map the more demanding combined term or derivative-symmetry task.

officialNegativeSourceDecision.meaning: Official graph transformations, coefficient matrices and Gauss do not establish Matrix-/Markov-/Fixvector duties. Preserve the negative official interpretation and prior HOLD as history.

The basis-image competency remains genuine unchanged preparation, not scored task coverage.
